changelog.note: Initial capture as user 1 on Asta with full access. Only QA-AUTO items were created, renamed, edited and deleted through the UI; the existing workspace files and folders, the storage figures and the team space named in Share to are live data and never touched or asserted. Download, Share to, Add more storage and Upload folder are never used.
